svg.title: Recover through probes and a bounded ramp
svg.desc: Open blocks normal calls. Probe admits bounded trial calls. Ramp admits 10%, 25%, 50%, then 100% of a calibrated safe per-dependency budget: illustrative shares, not production thresholds or proof of safety. Meter existing queued work and new requests within that same budget; stagger cache refill and never release the backlog at once. Advance only while latency and saturation remain safe. New failures stop the ramp and reopen the breaker.

text.tspan: Reopen traffic only while latency + saturation remain safe
New failures: stop ramp / reopen breaker
